questions.question: Against which great power is the oracle of Jeremiah 50?
What does God promise his people Israel in the midst of Babylon's fall?
options: That their guilt will be pardoned and they will return
That they will serve Babylon for seventy more long years
That their city will never be rebuilt
That they will be scattered among all nations
questions.answer: That their guilt will be pardoned and they will return

questions.question: Jeremiah 50 calls God's people to flee from the midst of Babylon.
